teaser.en: One Digo name, four different trees and shrubs. This is the Diphasia, a citrus-family tree known by its leaves.
teaser.sw: Jina moja la Kidigo, miti na vichaka vinne tofauti. Huu ni Diphasia, mti wa familia ya michungwa unaotambulika kwa majani yake.
teaser.dg: Dzina mwenga ra Chidigo, mihi na vitsaka vinne tafwauti. Uhu ni *Diphasia*, muhi wa jamii ya michungbwa unaomanyikana kpwa makodzage.

summary.en: Nchikoma is a forest tree of the citrus family, a Diphasia that botanists had not yet formally named. The same Digo name covers three other plants as well.
summary.sw: Nchikoma ni mti wa msituni wa familia ya michungwa, Diphasia ambayo wataalamu wa mimea walikuwa bado hawajaipa jina rasmi. Jina hilohilo la Kidigo linajumuisha mimea mingine mitatu pia.
summary.dg: *Nchikoma* ni muhi wa tsakani wa jamii ya michungbwa, *Diphasia* ambayo asayansi a mimea kala taadzangbweipha dzina ra chisayansi. Dzina hiri ra Chidigo piya nkuhumirwa kpwa mimea yanjina mihahu.

about.en:
This *nchikoma* is a *Diphasia*, a tree of the citrus family. Like its relatives it has compound leaves of three leaflets, dotted with tiny oil glands that give a citrus-like scent when crushed, and small white flowers.

The Digo pick it out by its leaves. Botanists listed it in the *Flora of Tropical East Africa* only as '*Diphasia* sp. A', a species still waiting for a formal name.
about.sw:
*Nchikoma* huu ni *Diphasia*, mti wa familia ya michungwa. Kama mimea ya jamii yake, una majani mchanganyiko yenye vijani vitatu, yenye vitone vidogo sana vya tezi za mafuta vinavyotoa harufu kama ya chungwa yanapopondwa, na maua madogo meupe.

Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake. Wataalamu wa mimea waliuorodhesha katika *Flora of Tropical East Africa* kama '*Diphasia* sp. A' tu, spishi ambayo bado inasubiri jina rasmi.
about.dg:
*Nchikoma* uhu ni *Diphasia*, muhi wa jamii ya michungbwa. Dza mimea ya jamii yakpwe, chila kodza rina makodza madide mahahu, genye vibara vidide sana vya mafuha ganayolavya arufu dza ya ndimu gachifikitswa, na una maruwa madide mereru.

Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage. Asayansi a mimea auandika kpwenye *Flora of Tropical East Africa* dza '*Diphasia* sp. A' tu, aina ambayo taidzangbwehewa dzina ra chisayansi.

where.en: *Diphasia* trees grow in the coastal forests of Kenya and Tanzania. Pakia recorded *nchikoma* among the Digo of the south coast.
where.sw: Miti ya *Diphasia* huota katika misitu ya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania. Pakia aliripoti *nchikoma* miongoni mwa Wadigo wa pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: Mihi ya *Diphasia* inamera matsakani ga pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania. Pakia waandika *nchikoma* kahi ya Adigo a pwani ya kusini.

culture.en: Its name begins with the prefix that Pakia reads as carrying a 'female' sense, as in *nchibandu* and *nchivuri*.
culture.sw: Jina lake linaanza na kiambishi ambacho Pakia anakisoma kuwa na maana ya 'kike', kama katika *nchibandu* na *nchivuri*.
culture.dg: Dzinare rinaandza na mwandzo ambao Pakia anaona una mana ya 'chichetu', dza *nchibandu* na *nchivuri*.

names.en: Pakia records *nchikoma* for this *Diphasia* and gives the same name to three other plants: *Ehretia amoena*, *Ehretia bakeri* and *Vepris eugeniifolia*. *Vepris* is in the same citrus family as *Diphasia*, but the two *Ehretia* are unrelated. The meaning of the name is not explained. No English or Swahili name is recorded.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti *nchikoma* kwa *Diphasia* hii na anatoa jina hilohilo kwa mimea mingine mitatu: *Ehretia amoena*, *Ehretia bakeri* na *Vepris eugeniifolia*. *Vepris* ni ya familia ileile ya michungwa kama *Diphasia*, lakini *Ehretia* mbili hazina uhusiano nayo. Maana ya jina haielezwi. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililoripotiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *nchikoma* kpwa *Diphasia* ihi, na dzina hiri piya anarilavya kpwa mimea yanjina mihahu: *Ehretia amoena*, *Ehretia bakeri* na *Vepris eugeniifolia*. *Vepris* i jamii mwenga ya michungbwa na *Diphasia*, ela *Ehretia* mbiri si ndugu zao. Mana ya dzina taielezwa. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa.

digo_proposals.note: also given for Ehretia amoena, Ehretia bakeri, Vepris eugeniifolia
